name: @aigency/contracts
description: Solidity smart contracts — HarvestMoon.sol (graft quality gate), AigencyGraft ERC-721, AigencyGraftAccess ERC-20. Base L2 (chain ID 8453).

scripts.build: command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 && forge build || echo '⚠️ Foundry not installed. Install: https://getfoundry.sh'
scripts.test: command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1 && forge test -vvv || echo '⚠️ Foundry not installed. Skipping contract tests. Install: https://getfoundry.sh'
